description.zh: 要查询的目的IP。设置该参数表示查询包含了这条目的IP的入侵防御事件。
description.en: The destination IP address to query. If you specify this parameter, all intrusion events with the specified destination IP address are queried.

description.zh: 要查询的目的VPC ID。设置该参数表示查询包含了这条目的VPC ID的入侵防御事件。
description.en: The ID of the destination VPC to query. If you specify this parameter, all intrusion events that contain the specified ID of the destination VPC are queried.

description.zh: 设置查询结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
云防火墙类型。取值：
- **VpcFirewall**：表示VPC边界防火墙
- **InternetFirewall**（默认）：表示互联网边界防火墙
description.en:
The type of the firewall. Valid values:

*   **VpcFirewall**: virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall
*   **InternetFirewall** (default): Internet firewall

description.zh: 要查询的公网资产IP。设置该参数表示查询包含了这条资产IP的失陷感知事件。
description.en: The public IP address. If you specify this parameter, all intrusion events that contain the specified public IP address are queried.

description.zh: 要查询的源IP。设置该参数表示查询包含了这条源IP的入侵防御事件。
description.en: The source IP address to query. If you specify this parameter, all intrusion events from the specified source IP address are queried.

description.zh: 要查询的源VPC ID。设置该参数表示查询包含了这条源VPC ID的入侵防御事件。
description.en: The ID of the source VPC to query. If you specify this parameter, all intrusion events that contain the specified ID of the source VPC are queried.

description.zh: 设置查询开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The UUID of the intrusion event.

title.zh: 获取入侵防御事件的攻击payload

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw describe-risk-event-payload --start-time 1669533617 --end-time 1681288980 --src-ip 203.0.113.1 --dst-ip 203.0.113.2 --uuid e62c25e0-1073-46bd-9567-b8f12b3d0000 --firewall-type InternetFirewall --src-vpc-id vpc-wz9j2lqyo15udw5nt0000 --dst-vpc-id vpc-uf6jr1klwqb60dyn20000 --public-ip 203.0.113.3 --region cn-hangzhou
